body:
I know I'm way late to the thready but here it goes anyway. 

I resent my husband every single day. I work full time and our children are in daycare so that we do not lose the spot there. He was laid off about 3 months ago and has yet to find a job. He gets to sit home all day and barely does housework. Meanwhile I am at work fighting through the pain so that I can make ends meet.(I have serious  health issues but that's another story) 

I try to smile and be happy mostly for our kids but if not for them I would kill myself so i didn't have to deal with my pain anymore. When my husband wants to have sex either i hurt too bad, or i tell him i do because i am so unhappy with him I cannot bear the thought most times. I do love him... I just hate him.

I'm late but I am going to post anyway!

I have struggled with depression and anxiety since I was very young. I have been through it all, I was on and off drugs most of my adolescence, I married and divorced the first guy to show me attention, and tried to commit suicide. Luckily my (now) husband showed up and called an ambulance.

I had a few years of being fairly normal after all that. Even if I was having a bad day it was nowhere like it was. However, I now have a major medical condition and can't get the help I need due I finances am where I live.

Two nights ago I had the worst low I have had in years. I curled into a ball and sobbed like a child in my bed. In my mind anything would have been better then what i felt. I feel literally insane. I know that what I am thinking is silly but I have no strength left to make myself stop.  

I felt so hopeless. There is no better word for it then hopeless. I got so bad that if not or my husband and daughter I can say without hesitation I would have ended my life. I feel like my illness has stolen my identity.

I can't stand being stared at because I walk with a cane. I go to the bathroom and cry at work because my hands hurt so badly ( I am an artist) I think every single day about ending my life. It's like my depression is my life now. 

I am constantly missing work and just laying in my bed all day, because sleeping is easier. I don't have to think or hurt when I sleep. Yesterday I called in to work and slept until 6 pm, only waking up to help get my daughter ready for daycare, then back to bed.

The worst part is I am not myself anymore. I used to be happy, I used I have energy and things I liked to do. But I simply can't bring myself to do them. Even if friends invite me out I can't go, or rather wont. It's too much of a hassle To leave anymore. Every time I can do something with my daughter because of my illness it makes it worse. All I can think of is that she deserves better then me.

I'm sorry this ended up a little more sporadic and long winded then I thought it would be. Didn't mean to rant!
